scope: Independent source and synthetic QA only; no debugger, app, device, native runtime, or live network execution.

verification.canonical_manifest_and_head_verification: passed: consumer 55/55 files and expected app HEAD; producer 28/28 files and expected producer HEAD

review_findings.finding: Native-built virtual-entry query profile was missing.
review_findings.evidence: The exact base query produced by RCTBundleURLProvider with additionalOptions=nil is now accepted. The Expo-rewritten virtual-entry query is also accepted. Synthetic verification returned accepted for both and rejected missing, duplicated, changed, extra, host/userinfo, and fragment variants.
review_findings.scope_limit: No actual device sourceURL was read; any other URL shape remains fail-closed.

review_findings.finding: Shared-pointer dynamic type was queried on the wrong SBValue.
review_findings.evidence: The helper now evaluates buffer.get(), validates the returned typed const jsi::Buffer pointer, and checks the dynamic type on that pointer. The pinned libc++ declaration confirms get() returns T*.

review_findings.finding: Stopped process and module identity were not checked before reads.
review_findings.evidence: The helper now requires eStateStopped and an exact configured module UUID before getter expressions, then rechecks stopped state/module identity after source pin verification and after comparison.

safety_review.expression_policy: Five fixed readonly getters, five-second expression timeout, all-thread evaluation disabled, breakpoints ignored; no ABI offsets.
safety_review.memory_limits: SBProcess.ReadMemory in 1 MiB chunks; 96 MiB source buffer cap and 4096-byte URL cap.
safety_review.network: Only fixed IPv4/IPv6 loopback literals on port 8081 with exact query profiles; direct http.client request, redirects/non-200 refused, no proxy handling, bounded response.
safety_review.integrity: Validates the 11 local pinned dependencies, implementation pin set, full 55/28 canonical source manifests and corresponding Git HEADs before and after comparison.
safety_review.output: Fixed status, SHA-256 digests, and byte counts only; raw URL and source bytes are neither output nor persisted.

remaining_limits: The expected module UUID and both runtime gates remain PENDING; this result does not authorize execution.
Synthetic doubles do not prove actual LLDB SBValue behavior, dynamic NSDataBigString resolution, getter availability, or stopped-frame locals in the installed app.
No current Hermes buffer/sourceURL was compared with Metro, so runtime source equivalence remains unverified.
